# A GamGUI Builder sequence, written for `gam batch <this file>`.
# It runs outside GamGUI: no preview, no confirmation, no audit record. Read every line before you run it.
# Each commit-batch waits for the step before it, so the steps run in this order.
# 1. Reset password (random)
gam update user alice@example.com password random changepassword off
commit-batch
# 2. Rename a shared drive
gam update shareddrive shareddriveid 0AFINANCEuk9PVA name 'Finance — 2027 '"'"'Q1'"'"' $budget'
commit-batch
# 3. Delete a group
gam delete group old-team@example.com noactionifalias
